urdu: کلی گل محمد میں کوئٹہ ثقافت کے برتن کس نے دریافت کیے؟
english: Who discovered the pottery of the Quetta Culture in Kali Gul Muhammad?
roman_1: Kali Gul Muhammad mein Quetta saqafat ke bartan kis ne daryaft kiye?
roman_2: Kali Gul Muhammad main Quetta saqafat kay bartan kis nay daryaft kiye?
roman_3: Kali Gul Muhammad may Quetta saqafat k bartan kis ne daryaft kiye?
